title: School is closed today
message: Westside Baptist Academy is closed Tuesday, January 20 due to weather. Classes resume Wednesday. Watch for a Schoolcast message if anything changes.
_howToUse: To switch the banner ON: set active to true, edit title and message, set expires, commit.
To switch it OFF: set active back to false, commit.

expires is optional. Give it a date and time and the banner hides itself once that moment passes, even before anyone rebuilds the site. Format: 2027-01-21T12:00:00-06:00 (that offset is Central Time; use -05:00 during daylight saving).
Leave expires empty and the banner stays up until someone turns it off.
Keep the message short. Say what is closed, which day, and when it reopens.
